title: Extract Roundel & Camera Preview Hotfix · v0.9.7
changes: Move the live Quest camera preview above the microphone, capture eye, and Extract roundels, instead of covering the right-hand Extract control.
Keep all three roundels in a fixed arrangement. Extract is dimmed before a source photograph is available, then turns green and stays clickable.
Hide the live preview when a photo is captured; the capture image and extraction action remain independent.
Preserve previously saved images, cloud objects, experimental modes, accounts, API keys, and request quotas.
Add a geometric regression test to prevent live camera pixels from obstructing the extraction roundel again.
